description: This file contains unit tests for the DateDatatype class in the org.openmrs.customdatatype.datatype package. It tests serialization and deserialization of Date objects.

classes.name: DateDatatypeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of the DateDatatype class, specifically its serialize and deserialize methods.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes a DateDatatype instance before each test case.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldReconstructADateSerializedByThisHandler
methods.description: Tests that the deserialize method correctly reconstructs a Date object from its serialized string.

methods.name: serialize_shouldConvertADateIntoAYmdStringRepresentation
methods.description: Tests that the serialize method converts a Date object into a string in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.
